Table 8-7  Key Diet History Questions for Patients with Hyperlipidemia
How often do you eat fatty meats (hot dogs, bacon, sausage, salami, pastrami, corned beef)?
How often do you eat fish? How is it prepared?
What types of fats do you use in cooking and baking?
What do you spread on your bread?
What type of snacks and desserts do you eat?

Section 3  Nutrition in the Clinical Setting
Table 8-8  When To Refer to A Registered Dietitian
•  A comprehensive assessment of nutritional status is required.
•  Negotiated and tailored behavior change goals should be developed.
•  Nutrition strategies to achieve these goals need to be established.
•  Patient needs counseling to reduce portion sizes at home and eating out.
•  Patient needs help with healthy food purchasing and preparation.
•  Continued reinforcement and monitoring of diet and lifestyle will be helpful.
 Source: Lisa Hark, PhD, RD and Fran Burke, MS, RD, 2012. Used with permission.
